## MSADrawOptions.highlightPattern property

Highlight residues matching this text (case-insensitive substring) or, with `highlightUseRegex`<!-- -->, this regular expression. When set, replaces normal per-residue coloring: matches render bright, everything else is dimmed. An invalid regex matches nothing rather than throwing.

**Signature:**

```typescript
highlightPattern?: string;
```
